### Summary
Concise description of the change.

### Risks:
- List concrete risks introduced by this change (refer to CORE_RULES.md).

### Tests:
- Link or list unit/integration/E2E tests added or updated to cover each risk.

### Flag:
- Server-side per-org flag name used to gate new behavior (if applicable).

### Rollback:
- Exact rollback procedure (disable flag for pilot org, revert commit, and any data restoration steps).
